item.title: Buy G+Money for offline expense totals?
item.description:
Buy G+Money for offline expense totals?

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Deciding whether G+Money's paid download can replace your multi-currency expense sheet? Inspect the category summary first.

What you can check

A spending summary grouped by category or trip, expressed in your home currency so you can check where the money went.

The published summary screen shows category totals and trip filters. It demonstrates the reporting interface, not a verified CSV export or bank reconciliation.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 2.1.10

Before you buy

Paid download. Currency conversion, expense totals and exports are included; no in-app upgrade.

G+Money is a paid download. Currency conversion, expense categories, trip or event grouping, summaries, and text or CSV export are included; there is no later in-app unlock. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Buy this app on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Choose your home currency and check the rate you intend to use. A saved or manually entered rate can be used offline; fetching a new live rate needs a connection.
  2. Enter the original amount and currency, then assign a category. Add a trip or event tag when that context matters; leave ordinary daily spending unassigned.
  3. Review the category or trip subtotal against your receipts before exporting. Keep the original-currency amount and exchange-rate assumptions in mind when comparing totals.

Know the limits

  • This is manual expense tracking and currency conversion, not bank synchronization, tax preparation, or a financial recommendation.
  • Converted totals depend on the rate you select. They may differ from the final amount charged by your bank or card provider.

When a simpler option is enough

A spreadsheet may be enough if you only need a short expense list and are comfortable maintaining currencies and categories yourself.

Before you decide

Can I keep recording expenses without mobile data?

Yes. Recording and using saved or manual exchange rates work offline. Do not confuse that with receiving fresh market rates while disconnected.

Is this G+Money Lite?

No. This guide links to the original paid G+Money, not the separate Lite app. The paid-download model on this page applies only to this App Store ID.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for G+Money. It is a paid download, with the included features available after purchase and no in-app unlock. Apple shows your storefront's current price before you confirm.

item.title: HoursTag paid download: prices in work hours
item.description:
HoursTag paid download: prices in work hours

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Comparing HoursTag with a basic calculator? Check what the paid work-hour calculation and history workflow adds.

What you can check

A price converted into work hours, with Need, Want, or Impulse tags and a history you can revisit.

The published calculator screen displays a price as work hours. The numbers belong to the App Store example, not to a user's income or measured savings.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 3.0.12

Before you buy

Paid download. Work-hour calculations, tags, goals and history are included; no in-app upgrade.

HoursTag is a paid download. Price-to-work-time calculations, spending tags, goals, history, and backup are included without an in-app upgrade. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Buy this app on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Set your hourly or monthly income in HoursTag. Check that the income assumptions reflect the comparison you want to make.
  2. Enter the proposed price and read the work-time equivalent. Treat it as one perspective on the decision, not an instruction to buy or avoid something.
  3. Label the item Need, Want, or Impulse and review the history later. A goal or wishlist can help you compare several purchases in the same unit.

Know the limits

  • HoursTag does not measure actual hours worked or replace payroll, a timesheet, or tax calculations.
  • The result depends on your income inputs and cannot decide whether an expense is necessary for you.

When a simpler option is enough

A basic calculator can divide a price by an hourly amount. HoursTag is relevant when you also want tags, history, and goals around that comparison.

Before you decide

Does it automatically discover my income?

No. You provide the income assumptions. That makes the result a personal comparison rather than a statement about your real payroll.

Does this link open HoursTag Lite?

No. It opens the original HoursTag: Hours to Buy. This guide does not describe the separate Lite app's free allowance or workflow.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for HoursTag: Hours to Buy. It is a paid download, with the included features available after purchase and no in-app unlock. Apple shows your storefront's current price before you confirm.

item.title: Lumi Math Planet: free core or full unlock?
item.description:
Lumi Math Planet: free core or full unlock?

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Before unlocking Lumi Math Planet, compare its free practice loop with the fuller content your family may need.

What you can check

Visual math questions and a progress view that help you choose another practice topic, without treating an app score as a school assessment.

The published progress screen shows skill categories and practice history. These are in-app records, not evidence of measured learning gains.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 1.0.13

Before you buy

First planets and the daily challenge are free. One purchase unlocks the full galaxy.

The first planets and daily challenge are free to start. An optional one-time unlock opens the full galaxy of content; it is not a subscription. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Download free on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Begin with an available visual question together. Ask the child to explain the picture or pattern rather than rushing to tap an answer.
  2. Use practice at the child's pace when a timed activity is not a good fit. Stop or change topic if the session becomes frustrating.
  3. Review the progress view with the child and pick a topic to revisit. Look for a conversation about the mistake, not a target score to promise.

Know the limits

  • Practice results do not diagnose learning needs, establish school readiness, or guarantee competition performance.
  • Contest-style questions are practice material, not official or endorsed competition questions.

When a simpler option is enough

Counters, a number line, or a short paper exercise may be the better choice when you want a completely screen-free session.

Before you decide

Do I need to buy before trying the learning loop?

No. Start with the free first planets and daily challenge, then decide whether you need the larger one-time-unlock content set.

Is this the paid Lumi Math Pro app?

No. This page links to Lumi Math Planet: Explorer, the free-download app with an optional unlock. Lumi Math Pro is a separate paid download.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for Lumi Math Planet: Explorer. Download the free core first; the optional one-time unlock is purchased inside the app. The in-app Apple purchase sheet shows the current local unlock price before you confirm.

item.title: Buy Lumi Bopomofo Pro: all 37 sounds
item.description:
Buy Lumi Bopomofo Pro: all 37 sounds

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Considering the complete paid Zhuyin app? Inspect the tracing activity before buying Lumi Bopomofo Pro.

What you can check

A guided sound-and-tracing activity for a chosen Zhuyin symbol, followed by practice games rather than an unsupported reading-level promise.

The published Magic Tracing screen shows Zhuyin stroke guidance. It demonstrates the activity, not a child's completed assessment.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 1.0.18

Before you buy

Paid download includes all 37 symbols and the included games. No in-app purchase.

Lumi Bopomofo Pro is a paid download. All 37 symbols, tracing, blending, tone practice, and the included games are available after purchase; there is no in-app unlock. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Buy this app on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. An adult chooses one familiar symbol and listens with the child. Connect the sound to a word the family actually uses.
  2. Open the tracing activity, watch the stroke guidance, and let the child repeat it without rushing.
  3. Revisit the sound in a matching or blending activity. Use the parent area to review practice, and return to paper when that suits the child better.

Know the limits

  • Zhuyin/Bopomofo is not Latin-letter Hanyu Pinyin. This is not a complete Chinese-character reading curriculum.
  • The app supports practice; it cannot guarantee first-grade readiness, pronunciation mastery, or a particular pace of learning.

When a simpler option is enough

A school-provided Zhuyin sheet and an adult reading aloud may be enough if you only need a few symbols or prefer handwriting entirely on paper.

Before you decide

Will buying this add more purchase prompts during practice?

This is the complete paid-download Pro app, with no in-app purchases. An adult should still make the purchase decision.

Can a heritage-language family use it outside Taiwan?

It can support Bopomofo practice wherever the family studies that phonetic system. Check device and storefront availability on the linked App Store listing.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for Lumi Bopomofo Pro: Zhuyin. It is a paid download, with the included features available after purchase and no in-app unlock. Apple shows your storefront's current price before you confirm.

item.title: Lumi Mission Planet Pro: what you buy
item.description:
Lumi Mission Planet Pro: what you buy

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Before buying Lumi Mission Planet Pro, check its completion card and the family record you would actually use.

What you can check

A mission completion card and a parent-viewable record of the actions the family marked complete.

The published Mission Complete card is an example of the in-app result. It is not evidence that the app changes a child's behavior.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 1.0.7

Before you buy

Paid download includes routines, custom missions and the parent log. No in-app purchases.

Lumi Mission Planet Pro is a paid download. The included routines, custom missions, buddies, rewards, parent dashboard, and backup are available without an in-app purchase. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Buy this app on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Choose one routine together and make the task concrete. A short, understandable action is easier to review than a vague goal such as being good.
  2. Use the app together and record the small win after the activity. Keep the real routine more important than the screen.
  3. Look at the completion card or parent log later. Adjust the routine to your family's needs instead of interpreting a missed day as failure.

Know the limits

  • The history records taps and family input; it does not independently verify that a routine happened.
  • This is not a behavioral treatment, medical tool, or guarantee of fewer conflicts.

When a simpler option is enough

A paper sticker chart may be enough for one visible household routine, especially if everyone prefers a shared physical board.

Before you decide

Is a subscription needed for custom missions?

No. This guide concerns the complete paid Pro download. The included custom-mission workflow is not a recurring subscription.

Should the child use the purchase button?

No. This guide and its buying decision are for adults. Use the routine activities together with the child.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for Lumi Mission Planet Pro. It is a paid download, with the included features available after purchase and no in-app unlock. Apple shows your storefront's current price before you confirm.

item.title: Trip Planet Plus: free trip or one-time unlock?
item.description:
Trip Planet Plus: free trip or one-time unlock?

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Deciding whether Trip Planet Plus is useful beyond the starter trip? Inspect the mission map before choosing the unlock.

What you can check

A trip mission map that gives a child a small real-world task and a visible place to record progress.

The published trip map shows the mission-path interface. Its sample family and trip are illustrative, not a record from a reader.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 1.0.1

Before you buy

One trip and starter missions are free. Plus expands the experience with one optional purchase.

Start free with one trip and its starter mission experience. The optional one-time Plus unlock expands trips, missions, companions, and premium content; it is not a subscription. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Download free on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Create a trip with the child and choose one safe, concrete task, such as helping check the family bag or saying thank you.
  2. Keep the activity within adult supervision and the immediate travel setting. The app is not a reason to wander away from the gate or approach strangers.
  3. Mark progress on the mission map together, then put the device away. Use another short mission only when it fits the family's day.

Know the limits

  • Trip Planet is a family mission game, not airline tracking, navigation, a safety system, or a promise to prevent travel stress.
  • Optional family iCloud sharing needs the appropriate Apple services and connection; do not assume every sharing action works offline.

When a simpler option is enough

A parent-made paper scavenger list works well for a single outing. Choose the app when the recurring mission map and collected trip progress are useful.

Before you decide

Must I buy Plus before creating the first trip?

No. The first trip and starter mission experience form the free core. Plus is an optional one-time expansion, not a paid download requirement.

Do missions need children's photos?

A simple travel task can be an action, such as helping pack or noticing a color. There is no need to make a child photograph strangers or share personal details.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for Trip Planet: Kids Quest. Download the free core first; the optional one-time unlock is purchased inside the app. The in-app Apple purchase sheet shows the current local unlock price before you confirm.

item.title: PhotoCream: free preview, watermark-free unlock
item.description:
PhotoCream: free preview, watermark-free unlock

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Judge PhotoCream's editing preview before deciding whether watermark removal and premium packs are worth unlocking for your workflow.

What you can check

An edited photo preview with visible color controls, so you can decide whether the result and export boundary suit your needs.

The published color-editing screen shows a café photo and HSL controls. It is an interface example, not an independently measured before-and-after test.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 1.0.7

Before you buy

Edit and preview free. One purchase removes the watermark and opens premium packs.

Download free to use the editing and look-preview workflow. Do not assume every premium pack or watermark-free export is included. A single optional one-time unlock removes the watermark and opens the premium packs. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Download free on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Choose a photo you own or have permission to edit. Start with a restrained look and check that the important details still look natural to you.
  2. Adjust light and color deliberately rather than assuming one preset fits every photo. Compare the preview before changing more controls.
  3. Check the export options and watermark requirement before sharing. Upgrade only if you need the one-time-unlock features.

Know the limits

  • A look or reference style does not guarantee an exact color match across different lighting, cameras, or displays.
  • Editing cannot establish that an altered image accurately represents a person's appearance or an event.

When a simpler option is enough

Apple Photos may be enough for a crop and basic light adjustment. PhotoCream is relevant when its look-preview and more detailed color controls fit your workflow.

Before you decide

Is trying a look itself the paid feature?

No. The free editing and preview workflow is distinct from the one-time unlock for watermark removal and premium packs.

Are my photos uploaded for the editing workflow?

The published app description states that photo processing runs on the device. Purchases still use Apple's store services.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for PhotoCream Pro. Download the free core first; the optional one-time unlock is purchased inside the app. The in-app Apple purchase sheet shows the current local unlock price before you confirm.

item.title: Mask My File: free preview or export unlock?
item.description:
Mask My File: free preview or export unlock?

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Evaluating Mask My File for recurring client documents? Inspect the cleaned-copy example and the first-export boundary before buying.

What you can check

A new redacted copy, reopened for checking, rather than an editable shape that merely sits over the original information.

The published Private Ready screen shows a cleaned example with solid redactions after the app's verification step. The label is not a legal or independent security certification.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 1.0.3

Before you buy

Preview any file free; the first real cleaned-file export is free. Later exports require one purchase.

Import, detect, mark, and preview files free. The first real cleaned-file export is free. An optional one-time unlock enables subsequent verified outputs and the unlocked batch workflow. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Download free on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Decide which fields the recipient actually needs. Review detected findings and add missed regions or exact-text matches yourself; OCR is a helper, not the final decision.
  2. For an image or PDF, use permanent solid redaction or removal rather than blur or an overlay that leaves the content recoverable. Text and structured-file formats have different masking options.
  3. Create the new copy, reopen it, and inspect the actual output before sending. Check every relevant page and try searching or copying the removed text where the format allows it.
  4. Confirm the destination and share the cleaned copy, not the original. Keep a separate original only when you still need it and are permitted to retain it.

Know the limits

  • Automatic detection can miss sensitive information. A Private Ready label does not replace your review or establish regulatory compliance.
  • Metadata removal depends on the format. This app does not clean information from copies already sent, remote backups, a VPN, or network traffic.

When a simpler option is enough

If a desktop PDF editor already offers permanent redaction and output verification, that may be the simplest tool. Do not substitute drawing a shape for a real redaction feature.

Before you decide

Can I inspect the file before deciding to buy?

Yes. Import, detection, manual selections, and preview are free; one real cleaned-file export is also free. Later exports require the one-time unlock.

Does the screenshot prove every private field was found?

No. It shows the published output interface for an example file. You still decide what must be removed and verify your own exported copy.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for Mask My File. Download the free core first; the optional one-time unlock is purchased inside the app. The in-app Apple purchase sheet shows the current local unlock price before you confirm.

item.title: CalDaily Premium: what stays free?
item.description:
CalDaily Premium: what stays free?

Published by Lumi Studio, the developer of these apps. This is a first-party guide, not an independent review or ranking. Screenshots are published App Store examples, not measured customer outcomes.

Before upgrading CalDaily, inspect a named calculation result and separate the free essentials from unlimited advanced-tool use.

What you can check

A saved result with a name and type, making the calculation easier to find instead of reconstructing it from an unexplained number.

The published result screen shows a saved dinner calculation with a name and type. It demonstrates a record, not a bank transaction or proof of payment.

App Store screenshot, not a downloadable output sample or an independent performance test.

Evidence checked: 2026-09-11 · App version: 1.0.2

Before you buy

Basics, history and widget are free; each advanced tool has three free uses. Premium unlocks themes and unlimited tools.

Basic calculations, history, the interactive calculator widget, and the default theme are free. Each advanced tool has three successful free uses. An optional one-time Premium purchase unlocks the other themes and unlimited advanced-tool use. No subscription. Current local pricing is shown by Apple; no fixed price is quoted here.

Download free on the App Store

A practical workflow

  1. Use the calculator or an appropriate tool and check the inputs. For a split bill, confirm the total and number of people before accepting the result.
  2. Give the result a meaningful name and type while the context is still fresh.
  3. Find it again in history by name, day, or tool. Treat the saved calculation as a record of your inputs, not as a receipt or payment confirmation.

Know the limits

  • A saved result is only as accurate as the formula and inputs. Loan, date, tax, and other practical calculations are not professional advice.
  • This evidence concerns the in-app saved-result workflow, not a measured widget-response-time test.

When a simpler option is enough

A basic calculator and a note may be enough for an occasional split. CalDaily is relevant when searchable calculation history is part of your everyday routine.

Before you decide

Does every calculation consume a free use?

No. Basic calculations and history do not consume the advanced-tool allowance. Each advanced tool has three successful free results before its one-time-unlock boundary.

Does saving a result charge or pay anyone?

No. A result records a calculation. It does not initiate a bank transfer, settle a bill, or certify a payment.

Where do I buy the right app?

Use the App Store button on this page for CalDaily: Calculator & Themes. Download the free core first; the optional one-time unlock is purchased inside the app. The in-app Apple purchase sheet shows the current local unlock price before you confirm.

CalDaily Premium: what stays free?
